 Human note: contact the duty operator for urgent exceptions.
+
+### Before you try to cancel
+
+Order Desk does not currently provide a way to complete a cancellation. The
+approved rule allows only an operator to cancel an order that is still a draft;
+it does not make a cancellation action available in this version.
+
+1. Confirm the order reference with the caller before acting.
+2. Establish your role and the order's current state. If either is unknown, stop
+   until it is confirmed.
+3. Use the table below to check eligibility. Even for an eligible draft, stop
+   here: this version cannot complete the cancellation. Do not tell the caller
+   that the order has been cancelled.
+
+| Your role and order state | What this means |
+| --- | --- |
+| Operator; draft | Eligible under the approved rule, but cancellation is not available in this version. |
+| Any other role; draft | You cannot cancel it. Refer the request to an operator. |
+| Any role; submitted | Cancellation is blocked. Submitted orders cannot be cancelled, including by administrators. |
+
+For urgent exceptions, follow the duty-operator note above. That contact does
+not grant permission to cancel a submitted order.
+
+### What to expect
+
+There is no cancellation completion confirmation to rely on in this version.
+Automatic customer notification is a proposal, not an available feature; do not
+promise a notification. Only cancellation eligibility has been implemented, so
+the cancellation workflow is partially covered.
+
+Developers and support maintainers can consult the
+[technical companion](../.sdcorejs/documentation/technical-docs/order-cancellation/order-cancellation.md)
+for implementation evidence and verification limits.
